name: HORNBACH Baumarkt AG Inhaber-Ak
summary: Hornbach Baumarkt AG operates DIY retail stores offering a wide range of products for home improvement, construction, and gardening. The company's stores provide building materials, tools, hardware, plumbing supplies, paints, flooring, garden equipment, plants, and related services. Hornbach Baumarkt AG is headquartered in Bornheim, Germany.
